welcome.headline: Live chickens, delivered anywhere in South Africa.
welcome.subhead: McCluckin’s connects shisanyamas, kota shops, taverns and caterers to approved suppliers and a trusted delivery fleet — one order at a time.
welcome.step1.title: 1. Order
welcome.step1.body: Pick a bird type and quantity, drop a pin anywhere in South Africa, and get an instant quote.
welcome.step2.title: 2. We source
welcome.step2.body: McCluckin’s matches you to a nearby approved supplier and schedules a driver.
welcome.step3.title: 3. Delivered
welcome.step3.body: Your driver arrives with your live chickens; count them together and you’re done.
